observed_mechanics: Keep this in ESI and read the map end (this+0x1c) minus the map begin (this+0x18) into ECX.
Divide by the entry stride with IMUL by 0x2aaaaaab, SAR EDX by 2, then apply the SHR EAX,0x1f / ADD EAX,EDX rounding: the signed quotient is ((end-begin)/24) computed with sign correction.
Recover the destination vector from the frame and call 0x004cd3c0 with ECX as the destination and the signed quotient as the pushed count.
Reload the map begin; if begin equals the map end, skip the copy loop.
Per entry: read the entry id at [EAX] into EBX, read destination->begin into EDX, store the id at destination->begin + ECX*1, advance the source by 0x18 and the destination cursor by 0x4.
